fit: Other population, active whole-fruit doses, chair-rise outcome
assessment: Ten-week five-arm older-adult trial. Compared fresh fruit at lower and higher doses directly, with other arms adding dried strawberries or capers. Pooled 30-second chair rises improved by about two. Model interaction p=0.999. All groups consumed strawberries. The endpoint was not falls and the trial did not enroll for Parkinson disease.
